title: Android LinearLayout: control label baselines
purpose: Check that CheckBox, RadioButton and Switch labels align by baseline with larger text in horizontal XML layouts.
changes: Baseline-aware layouts now use the rendered label baseline for these three controls.
steps: Find Control and text baselines below the Right-to-left layout switch. Each row pairs a small control label with larger text.
Compare the bottom of each label's letters with Large: their text baselines should line up in the CheckBox, RadioButton and Switch rows.
Tap the controls to check they remain interactive. Turn on Right-to-left layout; the columns should reverse while the label baselines stay aligned.
Choose OK if the rows work as described, or Reject with the row, problem and your device.
expected: Each control's small label shares a baseline with the larger text, in LTR and RTL, and remains interactive.
limits: This example checks Bhoo's current rendered font metrics and horizontal LinearLayout. Exact Android theme, font metrics and device visual parity remain unverified.
validation: Rust layout test checks all three control label baselines against larger text in LTR and RTL.
